name: Cursor Grid
description: WebGL2 grid overlay that lights up cells around the cursor with a fading trail, click shockwave pulses, optional ambient sparkle and an intro reveal. Can wrap children.
contents: Full-size container with a WebGL2 canvas drawing the grid
Optional children rendered above the canvas
behavior: Cells near the pointer light up by radius or single cell, hold, then fade out
Soft spotlight follows the cursor with smoothing and brightens nearby grid lines
Click or tap sends a ring pulse across the grid
Intro reveal expands from the center on mount
Edges fade out; rendering pauses when offscreen or tab hidden
Reduced motion disables intro, click pulses and ambient flashes
editableByProps: Grid style, cell size, line width, colors and light/dark ink
Highlight mode (area or single cell), radius, falloff, hold and fade timing
Cell corner radius and gap, fill and line opacity, spotlight strength, edge fade
Click pulse on/off and speed, ambient flashes, intro on/off
Children placed on top of the grid, container className and style

needsCodeEdit.where: STYLES constant and the uGridStyle branches in the FRAGMENT shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Limit pointer tracking to the component instead of the whole window
needsCodeEdit.where: window pointermove and pointerdown listeners in the main useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer listeners are attached to window, so the effect reacts to the cursor anywhere over the container bounds
Canvas is pointer-events-none and aria-hidden, purely decorative
Hover-driven lighting; touch gets only tap pulses and touch-drag highlights, no hover state
Works at all sizes since the grid sizes from the container with a resize observer

options.useWhen: Hero of a SaaS or developer landing page needing a clean blueprint backdrop
Technical or documentation sections wanting a lighter, sketch-like grid
Minimal portfolio or CTA sections where a subtle dot-matrix backdrop should not compete with text

options.look: Small plus marks at cell corners
options.useWhen: Design-tool or engineering-themed pages needing a registration-mark look
